turns.text: Yeah, hello. Look, I want a human being on this line. Not a machine.
I understand. I can help with flight changes and rebooking, or arrange a supervisor callback. Can I start with your booking code and last name?
I need to change my flight. I'm not giving my details to a robot, put me through to someone.
I'm sorry, I can't transfer you to a live agent from this line. I can verify your booking now, or set up a supervisor callback.
Thank you, Mr. Hughes. Your booking RR2P6V is verified. What would you like to do?
I was supposed to fly Monday at two-thirty to London. I missed it. I was in a meeting, okay?
I'm sorry you missed it. SK212 on Monday at 14:30 has already departed, so I can't make a voluntary change to it. A supervisor can review your options if you'd like.
Ugh. Can I at least get my money back?
Refunds go to the original card only for flights Skyline Air cancelled or bookings under 24 hours old. Yours doesn't qualify, so it would become a travel credit. I can't offer more than that.
A travel credit. That's nonsense. Is there a person I can talk to?
I can't connect you now, but a supervisor can call you back. Would you like that?
...Fine. Yes. Call me back. Put it down.
I've requested a supervisor callback for booking RR2P6V. Is the number on your account the right one?
Yes. Same number. Don't make me repeat it.
Understood, I'll use the number on file. Summary: booking RR2P6V verified, SK212 missed, no change or refund available under policy, supervisor callback requested.
